stemMarkdown: In a 100 m race, A finishes in 25 seconds and B finishes in 30 seconds. By how many metres does A beat B? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: B's speed is $\dfrac{100}{30} = 3.3333$ m/s. When A finishes at 25 s, B has covered $3.3333 \times 25 = 83.3333$ m. A therefore beats B by $16.6667$ m.
